title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterMeter
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterMeter. A water meter is an instrument intended to measure continuously, memorize, and display the volume of water passing through the meter. Subclass of WaterDevice and saref:Meter (saref:Meter imported, not separately modeled here) per the SAREF4WATR ontology, restricted to saref:hasProperty allValuesFrom s4watr:WaterMeterProperty and saref:observes someValuesFrom s4watr:WaterFlowProperty. WaterMeter adds real restrictions beyond WaterDevice so it is given a full schema here rather than a bare stub. Own properties: hasFabricationNumber, hasFirmwareVersion, hasHardwareVersion, operatesAtRadioFrequency, requiresPower (repeated from WaterDevice), plus hasProperty, observes.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WaterMeter'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: Geoproperty. Geojson reference to the item. Maps to geo:hasGeometry in the SAREF4WATR/GeoSPARQL ontology.

hasFabricationNumber.description: Property. subPropertyOf saref:hasIdentifier. The fabrication number of a device. Maps to s4watr:hasFabricationNumber.

hasFirmwareVersion.description: Property. subPropertyOf saref:hasVersion. The firmware version of a device. Maps to s4watr:hasFirmwareVersion.

hasHardwareVersion.description: Property. subPropertyOf saref:hasVersion. The hardware version of a device. Maps to s4watr:hasHardwareVersion.

operatesAtRadioFrequency.description: Property. The radio frequency (Hz) at which a device operates. Maps to s4watr:operatesAtRadioFrequency.

requiresPower.description: Property. The power (W) required by a device. Maps to s4watr:requiresPower.

hasProperty.description: Property. The water-meter-specific properties (battery/operating-time telemetry) this meter reports, drawn from the SAREF4WATR WaterMeterProperty taxonomy. Maps to saref:hasProperty.

observes.description: Property. The water-flow properties this meter observes/measures, drawn from the SAREF4WATR WaterFlowProperty taxonomy. Maps to saref:observes.
